name: decisionSearchForProduct
description: Opt-in native decision pilot: find a main-document product search input, submit through its native form, and verify main-document results. Iframe content is outside this flow's evidence. Does not add items or purchase.

productName.description: The exact product search query to enter

selectionCriteria.description: Optional search context, such as price range or brand, used when locating the search input

navigationTimeoutMs.description: Optional navigation wait budget in milliseconds; omitted preserves the browser host default.
